Text.019:
A Windows desktop launcher for one Python project.
One launcher.yaml, multiple launch actions; the launcher runs independently of the project's Python environment.

Run: action-specific parameter forms, presets, command previews, logs and execution status.
Settings: configure the environment, actions and parameters, or edit full YAML.
Terminal: persistent PowerShell, CMD and Python sessions in the project environment.

Shortcuts
Ctrl + ,    Project settings (outside terminal)
Ctrl + Shift + 1 / 2 / 3 / 4    Switch pages (outside terminal)
Terminal Ctrl + Shift + C / V    Copy / paste
Terminal Ctrl + mouse wheel    Font size

The built-in terminal supports basic VT rendering. Use System terminal for complex full-screen programs.
Environment initialization and dependency sync require separate confirmation; missing environments never fall back to system Python.

License: MIT; third-party components retain their licenses.
Release binaries are unsigned; manual DPI, IME and full business-workflow acceptance remain outstanding.
